AgentAction.description: One step for the driver. Unused fields are null.
AgentAction.title: AgentAction

AgentElement.description:
One interactive element. `ref` is the driver's handle for it (a CDP backend node id with
its frame) and is only meaningful within the observation that carried it.
AgentElement.title: AgentElement

ExtensionAutoApply.description:
True once per Apply click: the extension may Auto apply (it still submits only when every
required field is answered, after its countdown). False: fill only.
ExtensionAutoApply.title: ExtensionAutoApply

ExtensionAutoApplyClaim.description: The one-time code from the #jobhunt-auto fragment of the link ApplyShortly opened.
ExtensionAutoApplyClaim.title: ExtensionAutoApplyClaim

ExtensionFormField.description: A question on the page the user is filling, as the extension collected it.
ExtensionFormField.title: ExtensionFormField

ExtensionPageJob.description: The job as the page shows it, for drafting on a page that isn't a tracked application.
ExtensionPageJob.title: ExtensionPageJob

post.description:
One observe → decide round trip. Known answers are typed without a model call; the model
is asked only to navigate and for questions nothing else could answer.

get.description: Find the application for the page the user is on (when there's no #jobhunt-autofill).

post.description:
The user clicked Apply in ApplyShortly for a job board or sign-in site, which opened it in
their browser with a one-time code. Claimed once, it lets the extension Auto apply; reopening
the link, or a link made anywhere else, only fills.

Chat turn for the autofill panel's Assistant tab: a reply plus validated field values.

The fields come from the page the user is filling; nothing is stored, and the extension
writes accepted values into the page form for the user to review and submit.
